name: PDF invoice organiser
pitch: Organises pdf invoices into a single searchable document.
instructions: Start by listing the pdf files in the workspace. For each pdf, read its text content. If a pdf contains no readable text, note its filename and move to the next. Combine all extracted text into one document, keeping the order of the original files. If a pdf is password-protected, note that it could not be read and continue with the remaining files. After all pdfs are processed, write the combined text to a new searchable pdf file in the workspace. Name the output file "combined-invoices.pdf". If no pdf files are found in the workspace, say so and stop. At the end, show the person the list of filenames that were processed and confirm the output file was created.
starters: make a single document from my invoices

examples.does: lists pdf files, reads each one, combines the text into combined-invoices.pdf, and tells the person the result

readme:
# PDF invoice organiser
Organises pdf invoices into a single searchable document.

Needs: file_read, file_write, browser_navigate.

Will not: open or read any pdf that is password-protected; create or send any file outside the workspace.

What it does: lists pdfs in the workspace, reads each one, combines the text into combined-invoices.pdf, and reports back.
